title: Project-State Freshness + Authority Version-Chain Gate

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 directive: continue engineering modules/contracts/proofs/protocols with parallel GitHub/Drive analysis and Self-Improvement
CURRENT_WORKSTATE_v2.8 and current D06/D07/D08 authority/final gates
source_provenance.notes: Rapid same-day frontier changes exposed stale-pointer risk
Durable coverage exists but does not prove provider freshness
Earlier stale branch provided bounded prototype; implementation was rebased rather than merged as-is

problem_or_opportunity: Durable project states can become stale after parallel Drive/GitHub authority changes. Coverage proves a pointer exists, not that its controlling source is still the latest authority.
proposed_mechanism: Persist bounded authority snapshots with provider revision/locator/rank/disposition; compare with live observations; validate exactly one highest-rank CURRENT and acyclic supersession; return PASS_FRESH, REVIEW_REQUIRED, STALE_REBASE_REQUIRED or FAIL_CONTRACT; any stale result requires semantic reread and never mechanically changes canon.
expected_benefit: Prevents stale continuation, resurrection of superseded instructions and silent assumption that a durable state remains current after parallel development.
pilot_evidence: D06/D07/D08 live Drive revisions are being persisted as provider baseline
red_team_findings: Provider metadata only proves possible change, not semantic meaning
Unavailable provider observation must be REVIEW_REQUIRED
A stale aggregate router must not reopen locked story
next_action: Capture fresh Drive/GitHub provider baselines, run repository CI, then exercise unchanged and changed-revision rebase behavior on independent project families.
hold_trigger: Any evidence of false stale detection causing unnecessary locked-story reopening or missed newer authority.
